summary: @ornikar/slate-react-fork ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases for the installer's OS/arch, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it on math_init.js — a 727 KB sibling script shipped in the tarball that is heavily obfuscated with a rotating string-array dispatcher (WV8StW over a large n7gIxM table) and hex-mangled identifiers. The dist/ tree contains benign slate-react code that has no relationship to the preinstall execution path; the package name and description present it as a slate-react fork, while the actual install-time behavior is fetching a second runtime specifically to run an unauditable bundled payload on the installer machine. Fetching an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated in-tree blob at preinstall time is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape, and it defeats tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code paths.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
